DiagnosticReport.conclusion:
1. No acute intracranial hemorrhage or calvarial fracture.
2. Small left frontal scalp hematoma.
3. 14 mm extra-axial lesion along the left frontal convexity, most consistent with a meningioma. Consider nonemergent MRI brain with and without contrast.
4. Mild chronic small vessel ischemic changes.

_sections.title: CLINICAL INDICATION
_sections.text: Ground-level fall at home with head strike. On apixaban for atrial fibrillation. Evaluate for intracranial hemorrhage.

_sections.title: TECHNIQUE
_sections.text: Axial CT images of the head were obtained without intravenous contrast. Coronal and sagittal reformats were reviewed. CTDIvol: 48 mGy. DLP: 812 mGy-cm.

items.label: Brain
items.text: No intracranial hemorrhage, mass effect, midline shift, or CT evidence of acute infarct. There is a 14 mm homogeneous, mildly hyperdense extra-axial lesion along the left frontal convexity with a broad dural base and no surrounding edema. Mild periventricular white matter hypoattenuation, consistent with chronic small vessel ischemic change. Age-appropriate volume loss.

items.label: Ventricles and cisterns
items.text: Ventricles are normal in size for age. Basal cisterns are patent.

items.label: Sinuses and mastoids
items.text: Mild mucosal thickening of the maxillary sinuses. Mastoid air cells are clear.

items.label: Calvarium and soft tissues
items.text: No calvarial fracture. Small left frontal scalp hematoma.
